# Stockfish

ZugUp bundles the Stockfish chess engine (version 19 at the time of writing) in its standalone builds. It runs as a separate process; ZugUp talks to it over the UCI protocol.

Stockfish is free software licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 3. The license text is in `Copying.txt` and the list of contributors in `AUTHORS`, both copied unmodified from the Stockfish 19 distribution.

The Stockfish source code, for the version you bundle, is available at https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish and https://stockfishchess.org/.

If you build ZugUp with a different Stockfish version, replace `Copying.txt` and `AUTHORS` with the files shipped with that version.
